const bridge=globalThis.OmegaCanonicalIdentityRegistry||globalThis.OmegaCountrySemanticBridge; if(!bridge) throw new Error('OMEGA CANONICAL COUNTRY BRIDGE NOT LOADED'); await bridge.init(); const rows=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile('countries.json','utf8')); } const ctx=globalThis.OmegaCanonicalAIContextBridge; if(!ctx?.discoverCountry) failures.push({stage:'CONTEXT_DISCOVERY_API',reason:'discoverCountry unavailable'}); if(ctx?.discoverCountry){ for(const row of rows){ const name=String(row?.name||'').trim(); const expected=String(row?.code||'').trim().toUpperCase(); const hit=await ctx.discoverCountry('What is '+name); if(!hit?.id||String(hit.id).toUpperCase()!==expected){failures.push({name,expected,actual:hit?.id||null,stage:'CONTEXT_DISCOVERY'}); if(failures.length>50)break;} } } const dfs=globalThis.OmegaDataFindingSystem; if(!dfs) failures.push({stage:'DATA_FINDING',reason:'OMEGA DATA FINDING SYSTEM NOT LOADED'}); else { await dfs.init(); const d=dfs.diagnostics?.()||{}; if(d.ready!==true) failures.push({stage:'DATA_FINDING',reason:'DATA FINDING SYSTEM NOT_READY',diagnostics:d}); } if(failures.length){ console.error(JSON.stringify({ok:false,countryRows:rows.length,uniqueCountryIds:ids.size,failures:failures.slice(0,50)},null,2)); process.exit(1); } console.log('OMEGA DATA FINDING TEST PASSED'); console.log('Country records audited:',rows.length); console.log('Unique country IDs audited:',ids.size); console.log('Question entity resolution: PASS'); console.log('Context discovery resolution: PASS'); console.log('Data-finding initialization: PASS');"
